name: Embedded LLM — Benchmarking LLM Inference on Intel Arc Pro B60 (4x B60 TP=4, vLLM vs LLM-Scaler)
notes: 4x Intel Arc Pro B60 TP=4, Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct, vLLM 0.12 vs Intel LLM-Scaler 1.2. Concurrency 16/32/64, 1K->1K and 1K->2K scenarios. TTFT and TPOT reported; ~1000 tok/s aggregate at peak (64 conc).
